projects.name: Nexus ERP
projects.short_description: Full-stack business management platform with an ASP.NET Core backend and a standalone Vanilla JavaScript frontend.
projects.description: Nexus ERP is a full-stack business management system built around Clean Architecture. The backend uses ASP.NET Core Web API with Entity Framework Core and relational persistence, while the frontend is maintained separately with Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The platform brings sales, inventory, procurement, HR, finance, payments, reporting, notifications, and audit logging into one business suite.
features: Clean Architecture across Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers
JWT authentication with refresh-token flow
Customers, suppliers, products, inventory, sales orders, and quotes
Payments, invoices, returns, procurement, and purchase orders
HR, finance, budgets, expenses, assets, and depreciation workflows
Dashboard metrics, reports, notifications, audit logging, and health checks
Automated CI with restore, Release build, and tests

projects.name: HR System Backend
projects.short_description: Production-style HR management API built with ASP.NET Core and Clean Architecture for secure, maintainable employee workflows.
projects.description: A backend-focused HR management API built with Clean Architecture and separation of concerns. The system is organized into Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers and includes secure authentication, role-based access control, centralized error handling, repository abstractions, EF Core persistence, pagination and search, rate limiting support, health checks, CI, and automated tests.
features: Clean Architecture with Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers
JWT authentication and role-based authorization
PBKDF2 password hashing and authentication workflows
Employee-focused operations with pagination and search
Repository abstractions with EF Core persistence separation
Centralized errors, rate limiting support, health checks, CI, and tests
SQL Server support with SQLite for local development

projects.name: Real Estate Platform
projects.short_description: ASP.NET Core real-estate backend for listings, advanced search, bookings, favorites, reviews, and admin moderation.
projects.description: A backend for a real-estate platform built with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server. The API supports property listing management, search and filtering, sale and rent scenarios, booking lifecycle workflows, favorites, reviews, image storage, and admin moderation with role-based access.
features: JWT authentication with User, Vendor, and Admin roles
Property create, update, delete, and admin approval workflows
Search, filtering, sorting, and page-based pagination
Sale and rental listings with validated property images
Booking workflow with pending, confirmed, rejected, and cancelled states
Favorites, reviews, admin dashboard, and moderation endpoints
Swagger/OpenAPI, centralized errors with trace IDs, and Docker Compose
